::: remark

The running time of an [algorithm](expressions-algorithms.qmd#def-algorithm) is a [function](functions.qmd#def-function) of the size $n$ of its [input](functions.qmd#def-argument).
To compare running times, we ignore fixed factors and small inputs.
This page defines the notation for that comparison.

:::
